Calculate stream depth from USGS channel measurements

Source: R/calc_usgs_depth.R
calc_usgs_depth.Rd

Downloads channel measurements for a USGS gage and fits the at-a-station hydraulic geometry relationship \(D = cQ^f\). Mean measured depth is calculated as channel area divided by channel width.

Usage

calc_usgs_depth(gage_number, discharge)

Arguments

gage_number

Character scalar. USGS gage number, with or without the "USGS-" prefix.

discharge

Numeric vector. Discharge in cubic feet per second (cfs). Values must be positive; missing values are returned as missing depths.

Value

A numeric vector of estimated mean stream depths in meters.

Details

Channel measurements are retrieved with dataRetrieval::read_waterdata_channel(). Measurements without positive discharge, width, or area are omitted. Multiple channels recorded under one measurement are combined before the power-law relationship is fitted.

References

Leopold, L. B., and Maddock, T. Jr. (1953). The Hydraulic Geometry of Stream Channels and Some Physiographic Implications. USGS Professional Paper 252. doi:10.3133/pp252

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
calc_usgs_depth("06879650", c(0.1, 1, 10))
} # }
